summary: Iteration 67 - Custom Recurring Meetings, Sentiment with Attachments, Surveys Mobile Responsiveness: All 19 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend tests verified custom schedule editor with weekday buttons, Von/Bis time inputs, and mobile responsiveness of SurveysPage.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend refactoring: meetings_recurring.py and news_sentiment.py services properly extracted from route files
Custom recurring schedule validation correctly filters invalid weekdays (>6), invalid times (>23:59), and end-before-start slots
Sentiment analysis with attachment text extraction working - has_attachment_text flag correctly set when PDF/TXT content is folded in
seed_data_creation: Test meetings, news posts, comments, and attachments created during tests (cleaned up after each test)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 67 tested: (1) Custom recurring meetings with per-weekday different times - POST /meetings with recurring_pattern='custom' and recurring_schedule list auto-generates N occurrences with per-day durations. (2) Simple recurring patterns (daily/weekly/biweekly/monthly) regression - all working via /meetings/{id}/recurring/generate. (3) GET /meetings/recurring/{series_id} returns all occurrences sorted by scheduled_at. (4) Sentiment analysis with attachment text extraction - GET /news/posts/{id}/sentiment returns has_attachment_text flag per comment detail when PDF/TXT attachments are processed. (5) POST /news/analyze-sentiment accepts {texts, attachments} body. (6) SurveysPage mobile responsiveness verified at 390x844 viewport - header stacks, buttons wrap, dialogs fit screen. (7) MeetingCreatePage CustomScheduleEditor verified - shows 7 weekday buttons (Mo..So), Von/Bis time inputs, Slot hinzufügen button, weeks input, and remove X button per slot.

custom_recurring_meetings.create_with_custom_pattern: Creates meeting with recurring_pattern='custom', recurring_schedule list, and auto-generates series_id
custom_recurring_meetings.get_recurring_series: Returns all meetings in series sorted by scheduled_at with correct per-day durations
custom_recurring_meetings.regenerate_custom: POST /meetings/{id}/recurring/generate with weeks parameter regenerates occurrences

sentiment_with_attachments.get_sentiment_with_attachment_text: Returns has_attachment_text=true when attachment text extracted
sentiment_with_attachments.analyze_sentiment_endpoint: POST /news/analyze-sentiment returns results array with sentiment/score per text

schedule_slot_validation.end_before_start: Slots with end_time <= start_time filtered out

frontend_ui.custom_schedule_editor: CustomScheduleEditor visible with 7 weekday buttons (Mo..So), Von/Bis inputs, Slot hinzufügen button, weeks input, remove X button
frontend_ui.surveys_mobile: SurveysPage renders correctly at 390x844 - header stacks, buttons wrap, dialogs fit screen
